title: Egyptian myths
examples: Who were the main gods in Egyptian myths?
What did the Egyptians believe about death?

explain.say: Today we learn about amazing Egyptian myths and gods.
First we learn about Ra, the powerful sun god.
Next is Osiris, who was a god of the dead.
Isis was a very important goddess to her family.
Anubis was the god who guided the dead souls.
The afterlife was a journey after life on earth.

faq.q: Who was Ra, the sun god?
faq.a: Ra was the powerful god who controlled the sun every day. He was believed to travel across the sky in a boat.
asks: Tell me about the sun god.

faq.a: Osiris was associated with the afterlife and rebirth. He was often shown after being revived.
asks: Was Osiris a god of life or death?

faq.a: Isis was known for her powerful magic and her role as a devoted mother. She often protected her family members.
Anubis was the god who guided the souls of the dead. He helped people through the difficult journey to the next world.
asks: What animal was Anubis associated with?

faq.q: How did the judgment in the afterlife work?
faq.a: The heart was weighed against a feather to check if a person lived a good life. This determined their fate in the next world.
asks: What was weighed in the afterlife?

facts: Ra was the primary god representing the sun.
Osiris was connected to the cycle of life and death.
Isis was famous for her powerful magical abilities.
Anubis guided the deceased through the underworld.
The weighing of the heart was a key part of the judgment.

quiz.say: Who guided the souls of the dead to the afterlife?
quiz.why: Anubis was specifically the god responsible for guiding the deceased.

wrong.1: Ra was the sun god, not the guide for souls.
wrong.2: Osiris was more about rebirth than guiding the journey.
wrong.3: Isis was known for her magic and motherhood.

quiz.say: Which god was associated with the sun's daily journey?
quiz.why: Ra was the powerful deity who personified the sun itself.

wrong.0: Isis's focus was on magic and family protection.
wrong.2: Anubis dealt with the dead, not the sun.
wrong.3: Osiris was linked to the underworld, not the sun.

quiz.say: What was the purpose of weighing the heart?

options.show: To determine the next day's weather
options.say: To determine the next day's weather

options.show: To judge if life was good
options.say: To judge if life was good

quiz.why: The weighing determined if the person passed into the next life.

wrong.0: The judgment was personal to the soul's deeds.
wrong.2: This was a physical task, not a spiritual judgment.
wrong.3: The judgment was about actions, not muscle power.
